residualFindings.title: Repeated card exports with different decoys collide in discovery
evidence: crates/mnemocode-cards/src/content.rs:539
crates/mnemocode-cards/src/palette.rs:358
crates/mnemocode-cards/src/templates.rs:466
crates/mnemocode-cards/src/printed.rs:315
docs/audits/AUD-010-harnesses/src/repeated.rs:94
Local evidence: AUD-010-evidence/unicode-regression.log
residualFindings.reproduction: Encode the public all-zero 128-bit phrase as Unicode. Create two business-it exports with deterministic bytes 0x11 and 0x42 and retain one decoy. Parse each scene's XMP and verify exact individual text; then collect both.
residualFindings.expected: Individually readable exports remain separately discoverable together.
residualFindings.observed: Different Unicode decoys receive the same palette colors, export mark and document ID. The collector returns Different(13). Colors control has different IDs and passes.
residualFindings.impact: Discovery availability: two valid exports of one backup become unreadable together. Individual files remain usable; no incorrect recovered phrase is demonstrated.
residualFindings.recommendedFix: Bind export identity to the actual ordered decoy labels where labels exist, and to encoded colors otherwise, while retaining a shared identity across layouts of the same export. Do not ignore genuine conflicts.
residualFindings.requiredVerification: Keep original Colors and new Unicode positive controls; test independently randomized decoys, sheet/separate layout identity, and analogous SSKR card collection.
